title: 第24章 龙家人第25章 痛风套餐了解一下
content_zh:
跟校长商量好入学的事宜后，白月便直接打车前往祝言家中。
进门便能看到恢复良好的祝言正在书房内烧制陶器，就连白月走进他都没有发现，专心致志的做着眼前的事。
约莫一个小时后，正当祝言转头想找水喝时，才发现白月正坐在他身后，笑眯眯的看着他桌上已经拟好的初稿，吓得祝言连忙站起身来，不好意思的挠挠头道：“白小姐，你来啦，怎么进来了都不跟我说一声，你看我都只顾着自己的事情了...”
“无妨，你继续做你的，我看我的就好。”
白月继续看着手上的稿子，边思索着成品效果边思考着工作室运作的事。
白月在这漫不经心的看着稿子，一旁的祝言却是忐忑不安，紧张的站在白月身后，不时还观察着白月脸上的神色，生怕白月理解不了他的设计。
过一会，只见白月满意的点点头，把稿子放下，对着祝言说道。
“这个稿子我看过了，虽然只有四件物品，而且皆是粉彩瓷器，不过在这上面的设计的确是用了心。主题是梅兰竹菊这四君子，每一件瓷器上皆是以不同的植物为主进行彩绘，在细节上还采用了浮雕工艺，配色简约高洁中还透露着一丝大气，感觉很不错。”
“不过，我希望在一个月后你能将这四件物品完工，另外，我还需要一件样品拿去宣传，所以你需要抓紧时间制作。”
听完白月说的话后，祝言顿时松了一口气，原本紧绷的身子都放松了不少，见自己的稿子过关后，对成品的制造也更加的有信心了，当下便把柜中一件之前已经做好的成品交到白月手中。
“哦？看来你之前也在不断地反复推敲作品，才能得到这么一件巧夺天工的雪梅粉彩瓶，看这成品上的彩绘，竟是比稿子上的更加精细巧妙，很好！”
白月边不吝的赞赏着，边把成品小心翼翼的放在一个内里铺满天鹅绒的檀木制盒子中。
转而又想起一事，便跟祝言说道：“对了，祝言叔叔，过几个月，待工作室的事情初步落定后，劳烦你帮我到市私小走一遭，以监护人的身份帮我办理一下入学手续。”
祝言还以为白月要吩咐他做什么大事，原来是要办入学手续，当下便应承下来。
“没问题的老板，我一定把事情办好。”
白月也笑着点了点头，笑了笑，便不再多言。
走出祝言家门，白月便直奔古玩街的墨云斋去了。
刚要进门，便被门口的店员拦了下来，“哎哎哎！白小姐，您先稍等一下，我们老板还在里面见着客人呢！要不，您先在这店内逛逛，等会儿再进去？”
店员也是一眼就认出了白月，毕竟自家老板对这两兄妹都还是很友好的，不过，现在老板在见着贵客，不让外人打扰，所以只好让白月先在这逛逛委屈一下了。
听到楼下的吵闹，房里也传出了傅心莲清新温润的声音：“小轩，下面发生什么事了？”

名叫小轩的店员听到自家老板的声音，看了看身边的白月，忙回应道：“老板，是白小姐来了，我让她先在楼下逛逛，等您谈好了我再让她上去。”
“无妨，让她上来吧。”
随着房内傅心莲的声音落下，店员小轩也遵命的把白月请上楼去。
待白月进到楼上的厢房内，便看到了一副养颜的双美男图。
只见屋内轻烟袅袅，在一张黄花梨木的茶几上对坐着两个男子。
content_en:
After discussing the enrollment with the principal, Bai Yue took a taxi directly to Zhu Yan's home.
As soon as he entered the door, he could see Zhu Yan, who was recovering well, firing pottery in the study. He didn't notice even Bai Yue walked in, and was concentrating on what he was doing.
About an hour later, when Zhu Yan turned around to look for water, he realized that Bai Yue was sitting behind him, looking at the first draft on his desk with a smile. Zhu Yan was so frightened that he stood up quickly, scratched his head in embarrassment and said: "Miss Bai, you are here, why didn't you tell me when you came in? You see, I was only minding my own business..."
"It doesn't matter, you continue to do yours and I'll just watch mine."
Bai Yue continued to look at the manuscript in her hand, thinking about the effect of the finished product and the operation of the studio.
Bai Yue was looking at the manuscript casually, but Zhu Yan on the side was uneasy, standing behind Bai Yue nervously, observing the expression on Bai Yue's face from time to time, for fear that Bai Yue would not understand his design.
After a while, Bai Yue nodded with satisfaction, put down the manuscript, and said to Zhu Yan.
"I have read this manuscript. Although there are only four items, and they are all pastel porcelain, the design is really thoughtful. The theme is the four gentlemen, plum, orchid, bamboo and chrysanthemum. Each piece of porcelain is mainly painted with different plants, and relief technology is used in the details. The color is simple and elegant, but also reveals a touch of grandeur. It feels very good."
"However, I hope you can complete these four items in a month. In addition, I also need a sample to promote, so you need to hurry up and make it."
After listening to what Bai Yue said, Zhu Yan breathed a sigh of relief. His tense body relaxed a lot. After seeing that his manuscript passed the test, he became more confident in the production of the finished product. He immediately handed over a finished product in the cabinet to Bai Yue.
"Oh? It seems that you have been constantly refining your work before to get such an ingenious snow plum pastel bottle. Look at the paintings on the finished product. It is actually more delicate and ingenious than the one on the manuscript. It's great!"
Bai Yue praised it generously while carefully placing the finished product in a sandalwood box covered with velvet.
Then he remembered something and said to Zhu Yan: "By the way, Uncle Zhu Yan, in a few months, after the studio matters are initially settled, could you please help me go to the city private school and help me go through the admission procedures as a guardian."
Zhu Yan thought that Bai Yue was going to ask him to do something big, but it turned out that he had to go through the enrollment procedures, so he agreed immediately.
"No problem boss, I will get things done."
Bai Yue also smiled and nodded, smiled, and said no more.
After walking out of Zhu Yan's house, Bai Yue went straight to Mo Yunzhai on Antique Street.
Just as he was about to enter, he was stopped by the clerk at the door, "Hey, hey, hey! Miss Bai, please wait a moment, our boss is still meeting the customers inside! How about you take a stroll in the store first, and then go in later?"
The clerk also recognized Bai Yue at a glance. After all, his boss was still very friendly to the two brothers and sisters. However, now the boss was seeing distinguished guests and would not allow outsiders to disturb them, so he had to let Bai Yue take a look around here first.
Hearing the noise downstairs, Fu Xinlian's fresh and gentle voice came from the room: "Xiaoxuan, what happened downstairs?"
The clerk named Xiaoxuan heard his boss's voice, looked at Bai Yue beside him, and responded quickly: "Boss, it's Miss Bai here. I'll let her hang out downstairs first, and I'll let her go up after you've settled the deal."
"It doesn't matter, let her come up."
As Fu Xinlian's voice fell in the room, the clerk Xiaoxuan also invited Bai Yue upstairs.
When Bai Yue entered the wing upstairs, she saw a picture of two beautiful men.
I saw light smoke curling up inside the house, sitting opposite each other on a coffee table made of huanghuali wood.Two men.
